timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hey, I'm Deuliepa and I'm doing the wired, auto-complete interview.
Okay.
First one.
What is Deuliepa's real name?
It's just Deuliepa.
No middle name.
That's it.
It's Albanian.
So that's why it probably sounds a bit weird to everyone.
What Deuliepa song are you?
I guess I'd have to be older than really in some capacity.
What Deuliepa fans are called?
There's no set name.
I always just call them my loves.
They'd have to decide on their own.
I can't.
It's not my duty to name them.
What was Deuliepa's first song?
The first song that I put out was called New Love.
I put that out in 2015.
Oh my god, when I look back on that video, it's so crazy.
What is Deuliepa's accent?
Honestly, I have no idea.
British on most occasions.
Does Deuliepa have a Grammy?
I have two.
It feels so weird saying it.
Does Deuliepa speak Spanish?
I don't, but I bloody wish I did.
I feel like it's such a sexy language.
Maybe this should be my New Year's resolution as Lern, Spanish.
Does Deuliepa support Liverpool?
How do I say this in the best way possible?
I'm like, can you say like honorary Liverpool supporter?
Only because my dad and brother support Arsenal,
and I think I'd be getting in a lot of trouble
if I said that I just support Liverpool,
but I love Liverpool.
It's always got a special place in my heart.
Does Deuliepa like anime?
I do.
And my favourite anime is Ponyo.
It's the cutest.
I'm just obsessed with it.
Does Deuliepa play guitar?
I don't play guitar, but I used to play the cello in the school.
And then I got bullied about it a lot.
And so I quit, and now I can't play anything.
How did Deuliepa get discovered?
A bit of a long story, but I'll try and shorten it a little bit.
When I was young, I always wanted to make music.
I started making YouTube covers,
and I started showing them to my friends in school.
And then I used them as a form of portfolio
to work with different producers and get in the studio.
And I was like, you know, I sing, and I would love it.
If we could get in the studio and write together,
I made a bunch of demos.
And then I basically Googled Managers in London.
And then I got offered a publishing deal.
And I had to find a lawyer, and then the lawyer was trying to help me.
And I was like, don't sign this publishing deal, whatever you do.
Let me help you find a manager, and he introduced me to my manager, Ben.
And so that was a really, really long story, cut short.
How is Do-E-Lieper pronounced?
Do-E-Lieper.
It's quite easy, although growing up,
I feel like it was really difficult for lots of teachers
and people to pronounce it.
How tall is Do-E-Lieper feet?
Five for eight.
And my feet size six, you okay?
How to get Do-E-Lieper hair?
On occasion, a lot of it is bought and glued in.
That's quite easy.
I feel like anyone could do that.
But other than that, I struggled to try and make it look nice.
Bad hair days are kind of my thing.
What is homesick Do-E-Lieper about?
It was really, I'd spent so much time away from London.
And then it started pouring with rain in Los Angeles.
And it just made me miss London so much.
That's what homesick was about, was trying to get back home.
What are Do-E-Lieper rules?
Work hard and be nice.
What is Do-E-Lieper zodiac sign?
I'm a Leo, but I'm also a Libra rising.
And a Cancer Moon, so I'm emotional as f***.
But then really tough, so don't mess with me.
What is Do-E-Lieper's middle name?
I don't have a middle name.
Let's just do a Lieper.
Kind of wish I did.
What is electricity Do-E-Lieper about?
It's about love feeling so electric
and completely sending these electric messages
all up and down your spine and the feeling
that you get when you're falling in love.
It's a fun song.
This was really a kind of turning point for me
in terms of like confidence when I shot the music video
for electricity.
It kind of changed my life.
I was like, for the first time I was in front of cameras,
I was very much in the zone.
And I didn't really care what anybody was thinking.
And I just kind of let it all out.
And that song will always kind of represent that for me.
And I made that with my friends, Mark Ronson and Diplo,
so it's always more special when you get to do stuff
with your mates.
Can Do-E-Lieper sing?
I'm bloody hope so.
Otherwise, I'm doing what I'm doing here.
Can Do-E-Lieper drive?
I can drive.
I actually passed my driving test first time.
I would always get public transport,
but I do really love the freedom of just getting
in your car and going wherever you want.
Can Do-E-Lieper rap?
Only at karaoke.
That's where I like to rap, because I hate singing at karaoke,
so I like to rap.
Can Do-E-Lieper sing high notes?
I'm learning.
I'm learning.
I definitely have such a low voice.
So I've always struggled with high notes,
but I have been practicing and working with my vocal coach
to be able to just expand my range and learn some new stuff.
OK, who is Do-E-Lieper siblings?
I have two siblings.
I have a younger brother and a younger sister.
My sister is called Reena, and my brother's called Gin.
And they are the loves of my life.
Who is Do-E-Lieper the singer?
Interesting question to answer.
I am, I guess, Do-E-Lieper the singer.
I guess a songwriter first and foremost,
and Born and Raised in London, but via Kosovo,
which is where my parents are from.
And so I always feel like I'm from two places at once.
And I also feel like that makes me who I am.
Who is Do-E-Lieper signed to?
I'm signed to Warner Bros. Records, first in the UK,
and then in the US and the rest of the world as well,
and Universal in Germany.
Who is Do-E-Lieper stylist?
Oh, my amlore, Lorenzo Pasoco.
I love him. I love collaborating with him.
He's been with me for the longest time.
We've grown together, and it's been amazing.
Love him to pieces.
Who is Do-E-Lieper's mum?
My mum is an angel sent from above.
Her name is Anessa, and she's my rock and my superhero.
I wrote my first ever song when I was like four years old
and it was about her.
It was more like a joke. It was something at home.
It was in Albanian.
And it was all about, when I grow up, can I wear your dress?
When I grow up, can I borrow your shoes?
When I grow up, can I be as pretty as you?
And still, my parents make fun of me sometimes
and we still sing at home to each other.
Who is Do-E-Lieper's makeup artist?
Today, I have the wonderful Samantha, who I love.
She's amazing, and she makes me feel like a million bucks.
Was Do-E-Lieper in a movie?
No, I've never been in a movie.
I don't know if I'm ready yet, but I would love to do it at some point.
I enjoy acting. I just, my main focus is always music.
Was Do-E-Lieper on the voice?
No, I wasn't on the voice.
Was Do-E-Lieper on X-Factor?
I wasn't on X-Factor,
but earlier, I said I did a commercial
and then I got offered a publishing deal.
I did the commercial for the X-Factor
where I sang for one of their adverts.
And then I ended up working with a producer for it
who then offered me the publishing deal
and then I didn't end up signing that.
But it was like a series of events that happened,
which then led to me getting to do what I always dreamt of doing.
Was Do-E-Lieper at the Grammys?
I have been to the Grammys a couple times.
It's always really, really exciting.
I have some incredible memories there.
All right, what have we got?
Oh, last one.
Are Do-E-Lieper and BB Rexer related?
Love BB, we're not related.
We are both Albanian.
So I guess in that way, I feel like all Albanian people
call each other cousins or sisters
or whatever, like you see an Albanian person on the street
and you're like, yeah, that's my cousin.
But no, me and BB aren't related.
I'm from Kosovo and I believe BBs from Macedonia.
But we speak Albanian and we're very, very proud to be Albanian.
Are Do-E-Lieper an action-broncin related?
Again, not related, but I do see him as my big brother.
Also got the crazy Albanian roots.
And he also gives me the best restaurant recommendations
of all time.
Finally, are Do-E-Lieper and Taylor Swift friends?
I love Taylor.
We've met a couple times.
She's an amazing one.
What an incredible artist.
Done!
Thank you so much for watching.
Feel free to Google any questions.
And maybe I'll be back and answer yours.
Mwah.
